description:
Read payouts

Owed, available, requested and paid out, what is held and why, the payout address and the payout history (Requested, Sent with its transaction, Failed or returned). Payouts are sent manually in USDC on Base, usually within 72 hours: `canRequest` says whether one can be requested now and `requestBlocked` why not. Sellers only: an account that has not accepted the selling terms gets 403 not_seller.
name: get_supply_payouts
